threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when the bus stops without a signal, like it’s a set of secret handshakes only locals know.
The 77 bus last night had a guy singing old Skatalites tracks. Whole bus joined in. Never thought I'd see a Brixton karaoke on wheels!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found a kebab shop that opens at 3 AM, and the guy behind the counter knows my order by heart. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you enjoy a lecture about philosophy while munching on vegan döner next to a 80s-themed retro arcade. It's oddly perfect.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they know the secret spots to park when Civic Center's a mess, like that spot behind the old church. Saves you 30 minutes, easy.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Yesterday, I watched a whole Muni bus stop to let a mime finish his routine. Only in SF does public transit pause for street art.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but they miss the quiet plazas where locals sip vermut and catch up on life. That's the real charm.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still look at the metro map like it’s a puzzle to solve. Locals know it’s just a straight shot most times.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still get confused by the bus routes. Real locals can navigate the night buses with their eyes closed and a pint in hand.
Caught the N35 last night. A guy was passionately arguing with a lamppost about his ex. No one batted an eyelid; classic Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When you see a whole family of ducks waddling down Hermannstraße like it's their personal runway, you know you're in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a kebab stand that doubles as an underground music venue, where you can munch while vibing with local bands.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they avoid Civic Center BART during rush hour. It’s all about that unspoken understanding of chaos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy juggling on the platform while waiting for the 19. Completely missed his bus, but nailed the final catch.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think all Gràcia bars close early; meanwhile, locals are just warming up at the 24-hour locales post 2 AM.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their fascination with every corner café, snapping pics like tourists while locals just grab their coffee and go.
